Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

March 13th 1918.

Sir,
In consequence of information received in Peking from the Chinese Minister to Japan to the effect that the followers of Sun Yat Sen 孫逸仙 and Chen Tsung Hyui 陳炯明 are constantly leaving Japan for Shanghai, the Central Government has sent four detectives here to make enquiries. These arrived yesterday and reported at the Arsenal.
On 12th instant the Director of the Arsenal received telegraphic instructions from the Central Government ordering him to send rifles and ammunition to Kiangsi. The Director wired a reply saying he was unable to comply with the order.
Having received information that the rebels are transporting arms to the interior by means of junks General Yung has posted steam launches at Doo Kwan Lo Dou 杜鵑樓 Tong Ka Doo 唐家渡 and Loonghwo 龍華 . There are on each steam launch sixteen armed soldiers who search all boats that pass during the day and allow no boats to pass after sunset.
Four hundred troops left the Arsenal for Nanking on board the cruiser Tong Chi in the forenoon of 11th instant. On the same date 1,000 rifles and thirty boxes of ammunition were sent from the Arsenal to Hupeh on the transport "ZungZ". 戎
General Fong Nun Woo 方威五 is at present on a visit to Woosung.
At 11 a.m. 11th inst an alleged rebel named Tsu Ang Kong 朱長江 was arrested at the S.N.R.Station. Tsu had just arrived from Nanking.
Chinese who profess to be well informed of the present situation declare that the army of the Republic of Yunnan has not got such a set back as would appear from the telegrams from Peking.

Your Obedient Servant,
[Signature]
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（左侧批注：Endorsed on m.s March 13）
（左侧手写符号：CAD / KP）

秘书处东档
第 165 号
日期 12/3/4

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）

1918年3月13日。

先生：

鉴于从北京收到中国驻日本公使的情报，称孙逸仙和陈炯明的追随者正不断从日本前往上海，中央政府已派遣四名侦探来沪进行调查。他们于昨日抵达，并在兵工厂报到。

本月12日，兵工厂总监收到中央政府的电报指令，命令其向江西运送步枪和弹药。总监回电称无法执行该命令。

获悉反叛分子正利用舢板将武器运往内地后，杨将军已在杜鵑樓、唐家渡和龍華部署了蒸汽 launches（小型汽艇）。每艘蒸汽 launch 上配有十六名武装士兵，负责搜查白天经过的所有船只，并禁止任何船只在日落后通行。

本月11日上午，四百名 troops（部队）乘坐巡洋舰“通济”号离开兵工厂前往南京。同日，一千支步枪和三十箱弹药由运输船“戎Z”号从兵工厂运往湖北。

方威五将军目前正在吴淞访问。

本月11日上午11时，一名涉嫌为反叛分子的朱長江在上海北站被捕。朱刚从南京抵达。

自称对当前局势十分了解的中国人士宣称，滇军并未遭受如北京电报所显示的那般挫折。

您顺从的仆人，
[签名]
总探长。

警察总监。

（左侧批注：手写稿背书日期为3月13日）
（左侧手写符号：CAD / KP）
